verdict.rationale: The evidence documents domain availability search, registration, and alternative-name discovery. Nothing in it covers the breadth of the TLD catalog (hundreds of extensions), country-code TLDs, restricted TLDs, or per-TLD registration requirements. Generic search and registration capability is adjacent to this story, not evidence that it is delivered.

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD
